model: Not exposed by the built-in tool
rights: Original project m5 character redraw/extension with AI assistance; no third-party asset pack; no Deadly Days artwork; no additional license granted.
processing: tools/build_survivor_atlas.py: preserve native alpha, clear alpha <12 noise, round grid boundaries, premultiplied Lanczos resize, one fixed root per directional strip. No generated frames are mirrored or synthesized by code. Runtime normalization does not add source detail.
shared_prompt: Create a production 2D game character animation SPRITE SHEET expanding this exact character reference, not a redesign. Healthy tiny chibi anime, detailed painted outlined style matching reference, everyday clothes, orthographic elevated isometric 2:1 game camera with UPRIGHT bodies. Transparent background, no floor shadows. Square 2048x2048 with EXACTLY 8 rows and 8 columns, 64 full-body sprites evenly spaced. Imaginary 256x256 cells, feet root cell (128,224), character about 185px tall. No text, lines, weapons, effects, scenery or other characters. ROWS top to bottom: east right profile; southeast front-right three-quarter; south facing viewer; southwest front-left three-quarter; west left profile; northwest rear-left three-quarter; north back facing away; northeast rear-right three-quarter. All sprites in a row keep that exact direction. COLUMNS in every row: 1 idle alert guard; 2 walk left-foot forward contact wide stride; 3 walk passing right knee raised left foot planted; 4 walk right-foot forward contact opposite wide stride; 5 walk passing left knee raised right foot planted; 6 attack windup arms retracted body twisted; 7 attack full forward arm thrust weight forward wide stance; 8 attack recovery arms returning. Walk MUST alternate feet and counter-swing arms with distinct silhouettes, not repeated idle or vertical bob. Independently draw all eight directions, no mirroring. Keep face, hair, clothing, physique, colors, head volume identical across poses. Large transparent gutters, smooth clean alpha edges without colored halos.
